## TRA Timeline

#### Business Combination Agreement with Open Lending

- 2020-01-06: 8-K announces BCA with Open Lending, LLC; Form-of TRA embedded as Exhibit F to the BCA (85% sharing of net realized tax benefits from Section 754/734/743 basis adjustments at the Second Merger plus inherited tax attributes via Blocker contribution)
- 2020-03-18: 8-K reports Amendment No. 1 and Waiver to the BCA; no changes to the Form-of TRA
- 2020-05-22: DEFM14A circulated with the same Form-of TRA attached as an annex

#### Merger close and CIK handoff

- 2020-06-10: Merger closes; Nebula merges into a subsidiary of Nebula Parent Corp. (renamed Open Lending Corporation); Form 25-NSE filed for delisting; the executed TRA is filed under the successor CIK

## Explanation

Nebula Acquisition Corporation was a Delaware SPAC that signed a Business Combination Agreement with Open Lending, LLC on January 5, 2020, contemplating a Tax Receivable Agreement at closing under which the successor PubCo would pay 85% of net realized tax benefits from Section 734/743/754 basis adjustments arising in the Second Merger plus the inherited tax attributes that the Blocker (BRP Hold 11, Inc.) carried into the Blocker Contribution, to Open Lending's pre-close unitholders and the Blocker Holder. The merger closed June 10, 2020 and Nebula Parent Corp. was renamed Open Lending Corporation; this directory carries only the Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit F to the BCA. The executed TRA and all subsequent periodic TRA disclosure live under the successor CIK 0001806201; see `../open-lending-corp_0001806201/open-lending-corp_summary.qmd` for the post-close history. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record on the Nebula CIK.
